newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Royal Brunei Airlines names new acting MD.
newsitem.headline: Royal Brunei Airlines names new acting MD.

text.p: HONG KONG, May 6 (Reuter) Royal Brunei Airlines said it has appointed Haji Brahim bin Haji Ismail, 43, as acting managing director.
He succeeds Pengiran Dato Tengah Metassim, who has retired after a 14 year career with the airline, 10 as managing director.

A statement issued by RBA said Haji Brahim is rejoining the national carrier from the Brunei Ministry of Defence, where he took up a directorate appointment in 1994 after holding three posts, including deputy general manager and personnel manager, with Royal Brunei.
Haji Brahim said he was inheriting a "substantial legacy of achievement" from his predecessor.

"Industry forecasts show Brunei is best placed geographically and strategically to benefit as the ASEAN business and leisure market continues to expand at a faster rate than anywhere else," he said in the statement.
"The challenges ahead are certainly greater as we match the need to maximise our full potential in an expanding market with the most effective use of resources," he added.
One problem he noted was that the airline industry had seen capacity outgrow traffic growth, leading to reduced yield and revenues.
"Our challenge is to rationalise operating costs while exceeding the service expectations of our customers," he said.
